pages.text: Hold leather and right-click the $(item)Tanning Rack$() for a $(item)Scraped Hide$().
pages.title: Scraping

pages.text: Brew a liquor in a Farmer's Delight cooking pot and pour it into an empty cauldron to make a $(item)Tanning Vat$().$(li)$(item)Bark Liquor$(): four tree bark. ★3$(li)$(item)Tannin Liquor$(): bark and Barrowmoss. ★5$(li)$(item)Elder Liquor$(): bark and Emberroot. ★7$(br2)Hides come out as $(item)Tanned Leather$() of the liquor's ★.
pages.title: Tanning

pages.text: Each vat takes four pieces a batch and uses a level of liquid. Better liquids take longer: 2 minutes at ★3, 3 at ★5, 4 at ★7. Right-click with an empty hand to take the batch out, or to see how long it has left.
pages.title: The Vat
